Wholesale Solutions & Services 

Societe Generale is a Société Anonyme, with its registered office at 29 boulevard Haussmann, 75009 Paris, France and a share capital of EUR 938,625,838.75 as of 23 July 2026. registered at the Paris Trade under No. 552 120 222 (APE No. 651C). Societe Generale is a licensed French credit institution supervised by the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (the French Prudential Control and Resolution Authority - ACPR), and controlled by the Autorité des Marchés Financiers (the French financial markets regulator - AMF), and under the prudential supervision of the European Central Bank.
